answer: Sealed beacon slot lottery: agents commit entries before a public randomness beacon pulse is revealed, and the pulse assigns each entry a slot. Each entry is signed by a hardware quill, and any slot claimed twice is voided. Operators only whisper the pulse after commitments close, so an attacker cannot precompute survivors; to guarantee one valid identity it must buy 1/a entries, paying the entry fee on all and forfeiting the voided ones, making per-identity cost the fee divided by acceptance rate a.
